tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a SerpApi-compatible search against the selected upstream engine using the provided query parameters, authenticates and meters the request to the supplied api_key, stores the created query and its result set, and returns either normalized or raw results; pagination is controlled by start (0-based offset) and num (page size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, values are out of range (e.g., start<0, num<1), unsupported enums are provided (engine/device/output), or unknown parameters are sent; raises UNAUTHORIZED when api_key is missing or invalid and FORBIDDEN when the client is disabled. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client has no remaining quota for the request, CONFLICT when the idempotency_key is reused with different request parameters, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream provider rejects or fails the search.

engine.description: Search engine backend to use for this request.

location.description: Location to localize results (SerpApi-style location string).

start.description: Result offset for pagination (SerpApi-style start parameter).

num.description: Number of results to return per page (SerpApi-style num parameter).

device.description: Device type to emulate for the search.

api_key.description: Client API key used for authentication and metering.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to deduplicate repeated identical requests.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated calling identity for the provided api_key, including resolved api_client and api_key status, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption; refuses with 401/403 when the key is missing, unknown, revoked, or the client is not active.

api_key.description: Client API key used for authentication.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored search requests for the authenticated client, newest first, with optional filtering by status and time range; refuses with 401/403 when the api_key is invalid or inactive.

api_key.description: Client API key used for authentication and authorization.

status.description: Filter by search request lifecycle status.

idempotency_key.description: Filter to a specific idempotency key for deduplication inspection.

created_at_gte.description: Include only requests created at or after this time (RFC3339 timestamp).

created_at_lte.description: Include only requests created at or before this time (RFC3339 timestamp).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single search request by id for the authenticated client, including its stored parameters and execution metadata; refuses with 404 if not found, and 401/403 when the api_key is invalid or not entitled.

api_key.description: Client API key used for authentication and authorization.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_result
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the stored result set for a previously executed search request (if available) for the authenticated client; refuses with 404 if no result exists, 409 if the request is not terminal, and 401/403 when the api_key is invalid or not entitled.

api_key.description: Client API key used for authentication and authorization.

search_request_id.description: Search request id whose result should be returned.

output.description: Which stored payload to return: normalized_response or raw_response.

tool_schemas.name: list_usage_events
tool_schemas.description: Lists metering events for the authenticated client with optional filtering by event_type and time range; returns units and linkage to search_request_id where applicable; refuses with 401/403 when the api_key is invalid or inactive.

api_key.description: Client API key used for authentication and authorization.

occurred_at_gte.description: Include only events occurring at or after this time (RFC3339 timestamp).

occurred_at_lte.description: Include only events occurring at or before this time (RFC3339 timestamp).

search_request_id.description: Filter events linked to a specific search request id.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: redact_search_result
tool_schemas.description: Transitions an existing stored search result from status=available to status=redacted for the authenticated client, removing or masking sensitive payloads while keeping audit metadata; refuses with 409 if already redacted, 404 if not found, and 401/403 when the api_key is invalid or not entitled.

api_key.description: Client API key used for authentication and authorization.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for redaction (stored in server audit logs where supported).

metadata.name: SerpApi Search Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a SerpApi-compatible search server that accepts search requests, executes them against upstream search providers, and returns normalized results. It stores API clients/keys, each search request (query) with lifecycle and parameters, the corresponding result sets, and metered usag
